description: Build a deterministic editorial carousel deck from accepted copy. This does not render, save, or publish it.

cta.description: Optional call to action on the final slide.

handle.description: Optional brand handle shown in the slide footer.

hook.description: Cover line on the first slide.

payoff.description: Closing takeaway on the final slide.

points.description: Body beats in order. listicle lists them on one slide, manifesto gives each its own slide, before-after uses the first as the problem and the last as the contrast, and value-first-reveal uses the first three.

subtitle.description: Optional cover subtitle under the hook.

name: scaffold_carousel_deck
title: Scaffold carousel deck
